tags.name: Pen y Benglog
tags.note: elevation found on various historic maps from 1840s to the 1960s, the spot height for the peak is given as 1194 feet which is 363.93 meters

tags.name: Cefnycerrig
tags.note: on old maps from the 1840s to the 1960s this is the location of the trig point for this peak
an OS map from between 1840 and 1880 shows the inscription should read Carnarvon 14 / Capel-Curig 3 11/16, the actual milestone is extremely worn so this can not be seen

tags.name: Nant Efan
tags.note: Stream named after Evan Roberts - a local botanist and the first Warden of Cwm Idwal for the Nature Conservancy Council.
